name: Occasional One-Sided Getback of Full Cube
proof: The established O1G/compression lemma gives $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{o1g}}\geq\mathrm{USC}$, and the full cube has established unlabeled-compression value n. The same lemma gives $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{o1g}}\leq\mathrm L$, while the full cube has Littlestone dimension n. Thus both bounds coincide at n.
